newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor oil futures up on rising world demand.
newsitem.headline: India castor oil futures up on rising world demand.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery rose to 1,151/1,152 rupees per quintal from 1,143/1,144 rupees on Thursday on fresh speculative buying, traders said.
"An uptrend in the world market and overseas enquiries triggered bull buying while short covering aided the rally," a trader said.
"Foreign buyers are demanding Indian castor oil at $705/710 a tonne while Indian offers were at $735/740," he said.
In Rotterdam, castor oil spot prices jumped by $15 to $825 per tonne, local traders said.
In Bombay, groundnut oil rose by two to three rupees to 372/373 rupees per 10 kg on limited inflows from Gujarat due to riots in the Gujarat region, traders said.

In Rajkot, spot groundnut oil was steady at 580/585 rupees per 15 kg. Imported palm-oil slid by a rupee to 261/262 rupees per 10 kg in Bombay as local importers booked profits after a recent rally in the prices.
Traders were expecting fresh arrivals at the Bombay port next week.
